Eight non-test files in `django/` call `get_resolver`. I found them with the code index and checked the list against a plain text search of `django/`; both gave the same files.

- `django/conf/urls/i18n.py:31`, in `is_language_prefix_patterns_used`
- `django/contrib/admindocs/views.py:146` and `:170`, in `ViewIndexView.get_context_data` and `ViewDetailView._get_view_func`
- `django/core/checks/urls.py:15`, `:43` and `:129`, in `check_url_config`, `check_url_namespaces_unique` and `check_custom_error_handlers`
- `django/core/handlers/base.py:309` and `:311`, in `BaseHandler.resolve_request`
- `django/core/handlers/exception.py`, six calls in `response_for_exception` (lines 69, 74, 86, 103, 135 and 141)
- `django/urls/base.py:24` and `:30`, in `resolve` and `reverse`
- `django/utils/autoreload.py:337`, in `BaseReloader.run`
- `django/urls/resolvers.py:111`: `get_resolver` is defined here at line 108 and is never called in this file. However, `get_ns_resolver` (lines 120 and 127) and `URLResolver.resolve` (line 713) call the cached builder `_get_cached_resolver` directly. That function is the cached function that `get_resolver` hands its work to.

All except `base.py` import it as `from django.urls import get_resolver`; `django/urls/base.py` imports it from `.resolvers`. I left out `django/urls/__init__.py` because it only re-exports the name and never calls it.
